approved_command_preview: Validate the DCOIR review quality-retry runtime-wrapper compatibility fix from a real GitHub Actions checkout. Confirm commit 986acede358b127200684cdfbb256ec1f2ae5788 is an ancestor of the checked-out main history, run python --version, run python .github/dcoir_review/scripts/openrouter_pr_review_quality_recovery_selftest.py, and print a clear success line.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$expected = '986acede358b127200684cdfbb256ec1f2ae5788'
$actual = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
Write-Host "checkout_sha=$actual"
git cat-file -e "${expected}^{commit}"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Expected fix commit $expected is not present in checkout" }
git merge-base --is-ancestor $expected HEAD
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Expected fix commit $expected is not an ancestor of checkout $actual" }
python --version
python .github/dcoir_review/scripts/openrouter_pr_review_quality_recovery_selftest.py
Write-Host 'DCOIR retry-wrapper selftest completed successfully.'
